authority.source: Owner, 2026-10-19: "Yes, please turn the selected extensions into precise executable specs and reconcile the complete plan with current main." Adopts H0 and E1–E8 from the reconciled full-run proposal for the production-page programme. Authorizes planning/documentation and main reconciliation, not feature implementation, opening a run, deployment or claiming acceptance. Execution requires the separate parent start instruction and finite project authorization. 2026-10-20, owner: "Update the production-page plan so the run never stops for an owner check that agents can do themselves. Planning only: no product code (a runner change, if needed, goes in its own verified PR)." Guiding principle, same day: "the owner cares about the outcome and the goal, not rules for their own sake. Read every rule, limit and gate for its purpose." Invariants stay binding (land only through /queue-merge; only the merge queue writes main). Decisions A-H (no owner thumbs-up gates; one cloud coordinator with non-gating laptop checks; the final owner block H0.2 then S is the only owner wait; human trials become trial kits; Q agent-run with each record gating only its phase; all features kept, E3 AC-4 to #1531 and our own replay server; E4 ingress limits and a smaller E8 fixture; C2 tick on the existing CRON_SECRET behind a switch within Pro included usage), review fixes 1-12 and the same-day additions 13-16 (free stop and continue in any session; a coordinator never idle while it waits; a laptop helper session with the repository as its channel; a progress check for silent workers, CI timeouts unchanged). Recorded in production-page-refactor/evidence/owner-decisions-2026-10-20.md. This authorizes the plan update only: no implementation, run opening or completed acceptance is authorized or claimed.
